_note: All spoken text. One entry per clip; id = scene id + letter (s02a, s02b). A clip is one to three sentences. Split a clip where you need a pause you control. 'pronounce' gives the voice another spelling for a word; subtitles keep the written word. 'samples' are the voices --samples makes for the person to choose from.
